gloss: time deposit; fixed-term deposit; term savings

definitions.gloss: time deposit; fixed-term deposit; term savings
definitions.explanation: A type of bank deposit where money is deposited for a set period of time at a fixed interest rate. Early withdrawal typically incurs a penalty or reduced interest.

examples.japanese: {定期預金|ていきよきん}に{預|あず}ける。
examples.english: To put money in a time deposit.

examples.japanese: {定期預金|ていきよきん}の{金利|きんり}が{低|ひく}い。
examples.english: The interest rate on time deposits is low.

examples.japanese: {一年|いちねん}{定期預金|ていきよきん}が{満期|まんき}を{迎|むか}えた。
examples.english: My one-year time deposit has reached maturity.

examples.japanese: {普通預金|ふつうよきん}よりも{定期預金|ていきよきん}の{方|ほう}が{利率|りりつ}が{高|たか}い。
examples.english: Time deposits have a higher interest rate than regular savings accounts.

notes:
Compound of {定期|ていき} (fixed-term) and {預金|よきん} (deposit/savings). Often abbreviated as {定期|ていき} in casual speech. A basic financial product offered by all Japanese banks.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {定期預金|ていきよきん}を{組|く}む: to set up a time deposit
- {定期預金|ていきよきん}を{解約|かいやく}する: to cancel/withdraw a time deposit early
- {定期預金|ていきよきん}の{満期|まんき}: maturity of a time deposit
- {定期預金|ていきよきん}の{金利|きんり}: time deposit interest rate
- {一年|いちねん}{定期|ていき}: one-year term deposit

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {普通預金|ふつうよきん}: regular savings account — money can be freely deposited and withdrawn, lower interest
- {貯金|ちょきん}: savings — general term for saving money, can refer to postal savings specifically
- {積立|つみたて}{預金|よきん}: installment savings — regular deposits over time toward a savings goal
